scope: Prevent stale note terminology from being relabeled as current translation; close inference admission during shutdown

translation.reproduced_red: Real Engine note edit adds omascribe while a human-protected source stays byte/revision identical; worker-open refresh wrongly rebound old Terms to the new cache key.
fix: Capture effective note/glossary terms and environments under one Store guard.
Before runtime rebinding, verify actual effective terms, meeting/run, speaker names, cached actor identity and every pending source. Check even when the environment key is unchanged.
Apply the same content check before committing model or literal captions. Changed content defers; human source text remains intact.
Allow runtime-only changes and CPU fallback to reload pending progress under the new execution identity.
controls: real note edit with protected source
note write before terminology dependency catches up
changed actor or second queued source cannot partially rebind keys
existing runtime-change and CPU-fallback controls retained
translation.resource_scope: Rechecks effective terms, not whole-note byte equality; source actor digest uses the existing cache. At most four pending source rows are checked on rebind; no extra model request is introduced.

shutdown.reproduced_red: Engine shutdown still permitted new inference admission; scheduler/admission could reset the cancellation flag.
fix: Permanent shutdown state closes admission and stops scheduler loops; ordinary cancellation stays reusable.
All three async inference admissions recheck permanent shutdown when resetting cancellation, including optional GPU verification.
CLI RAII guard covers success and early errors, invokes shutdown, then allows at most five additional seconds for admitted task cancellation/trace work.
Observe config-lock handoff before trusting note_busy=false; a deadline or unavailable handoff reports unknown.
limits: Five seconds is task grace after existing shutdown work, not a total bound on OS calls or capture shutdown.
Task drain does not prove a native child/process tree has exited; timeout explicitly reports worker_exit=not_verified.
No new actual Metal cancellation run or installer validation was performed in this change.

release_status: Stable 0.3.4; 0.3.5 not published. Q16 minutes quality and recorded-audio admission remain open.
gpu_delivery: Existing separate CUDA/Vulkan components retained; no installer or GPU-component rebuild.

harness_portability.result: Initial Python CI failed because the new process cleanup tests relied on optional psutil. Core/ASR Rust and Clippy passed; Windows-core, Linux compatibility and Website passed.
harness_portability.local_reproduction: Hiding psutil reproduced the same two failures and one error.
harness_portability.fix: Unit tests isolate the optional collector while still exercising real child launch, kill, wait, reader and group exit. The actual ASR gate requires psutil before copying assets or starting a worker and still rejects missing exit evidence.
harness_portability.scope: Python harness only; no production Rust change, repeated model trial or new installer/GPU build.
